source_title: USDA Economic Research Service, 2023 Rural-Urban Continuum Codes
classification_rule: RUCC 1–3 = Urban/metro; 4–9 = Rural/nonmetro. County-level metro proxy, not Census urban residence.
population_source: 2020 Census Demographic and Housing Characteristics File, as distributed by USDA ERS
population_unit: Total county residents, all ages and sexes
processing: Archive original header and all FIPS 06 rows byte-for-byte; pivot Attribute/Value by five-digit FIPS; parse RUCC_2023 and Population_2020 as integers; join boundary CENSUS_GEOID; assert 58 one-to-one county matches. Region assignments are transcribed from the cited county lists and validated for exhaustive, disjoint coverage. No imputation or alteration of experimental inputs.
